cases.name: linearHistory
cases.description: One lane, one color; HEAD and branch labels split from the checkout decoration.

cases.name: forkAndMerge
cases.description: A merge opens a second lane for its later parent and the branch converges into the first-parent lane.

cases.name: octopusMerge
cases.description: Three merge parents fan out to three lanes and converge on the root.

cases.name: headOrdering
cases.description: origin/main seeds the layout before local main, other branches, tags, and unreferenced tips.

cases.name: naturalHeadOrder
cases.description: Equal-priority branches order by natural name, so release/2 precedes release/10.

cases.name: remoteNames
cases.description: A bare remote-tracking name is typed as remote only when the host supplies the remote short names.

cases.name: pageOne
cases.description: The first history page ends with a parent outside the loaded window.

cases.name: pageTwo
cases.description: The cumulative window after loading the next page resolves the missing parent.

cases.name: windowAfterRefresh
cases.description: A refresh adds a newer commit; main keeps its color because the head fragment is keyed by name.

cases.name: branchScopeWithRepositoryContext
cases.description: A branch scope keeps the repository graph's layout indices, colors, and base order.

cases.name: incompleteRepositoryContext
cases.description: A context that does not cover every scoped commit is ignored, never dropping commits.

cases.name: duplicateCommits
cases.description: A repeated hash keeps only its first row, so overlapping pages cannot draw a commit twice.

cases.name: filteredDottedAncestor
cases.description: Hidden linear ancestors collapse into one dotted edge between the visible endpoints.

cases.name: filteredHiddenDiamond
cases.description: Direct merge parents stay solid; a visible ancestor reached only through hidden commits is dotted.

cases.name: filteredDirectEdgeWins
cases.description: A direct parent wins over a second path through hidden commits to the same visible ancestor.

cases.name: filteredMissingParents
cases.description: Hidden commits project their unloaded parents onto the visible descendants; unrelated hidden roots add nothing.

cases.name: filteredBoundaryStopsAtVisible
cases.description: Unloaded-parent propagation stops at a visible ancestor, which owns its own continuation.

cases.name: filteredEmpty
cases.description: A filter that matches nothing produces no rows and no missing-history notice.

cases.name: missingParentLastRow
cases.description: An unloaded parent draws a terminal arrow on the next row, never a fabricated target.

cases.name: compactLongEdge
cases.description: A 31-row edge reaches the 30-row compact limit, so only its two ends are drawn with arrows.

cases.name: currentBranchAncestry
cases.description: currentBranch lists every ancestor, following all merge parents through the repository context.

cases.name: expandedMode
cases.description: Expanded mode keeps a 31-row edge as a full lane with no compaction.
